data_fields.name: fast_warmup_divider
data_fields.donor_constant: 10, then down by 1 per pass to 1

best_idea: One server cycle hands the world the measured previous cycle, fills the rest of the step window with packet intake, and runs every periodic job through an interval limiter that carries its remainder.
decision_why: Keep the interval-limiter-with-debt pattern for zone timers (row 23) and the decaying lag estimate as a health readout; reject the measured variable dtime for the duel step (kill order must not depend on load) and cap intake per step.
acceptance: A server test injects a 300 ms stall and asserts the duel step runs the fixed step count, a zone timer fires once per interval with its remainder carried, and 1,000 queued packets cannot extend one step past its budget.
